tool_input.command:
echo "=== macOS version ==="; sw_vers
echo; echo "=== Xcode ==="; xcodebuild -version 2>&1 | head -5
echo; echo "=== Swift ==="; swift --version 2>&1 | head -3
echo; echo "=== macOS SDKs available ==="; xcodebuild -showsdks 2>/dev/null | grep -i macos
tool_input.description: Check macOS, Xcode, and Swift toolchain versions
